byte_budget_note: Sum of manifest layer sizes plus config sizes. Conservative additive download budget; shared blobs can reduce physical disk use. Does not measure runtime RAM/VRAM.
operating_policy: 50 selectable local models; load one at a time. Keep initial text-only context modest. No paid API or cloud tag. Model availability is verified; hardware compatibility requires smoke tests.
fingerprint_rule: Sorted digests of application/vnd.ollama.image.model layers only; excludes projector/draft/template/license/params. All 50 main and 10 reserves have unique fingerprints. Training/size/architecture identity inspected so different quantizations do not inflate count.
free_scope: Public registry downloads require no auth or paid API. Selected50 contain no Qwen Research License-only entries. Apache/MIT and documented community/model licenses apply.
